units.summary: Freight document processing was identified as the best candidate for the first proof of concept because it has high volume, a measurable baseline and a clear business case.
units.quote: First, we think the freight document processing is the best candidate for a first proof of concept. High volume, a clear baseline with clerk hours and error rates, and a clear business case.

units.summary: The advisors identified document processing as the best first candidate, citing its high volume and measurable baseline.
units.quote: Document processing is the best first candidate: high volume, measurable baseline (clerk hours, error rate), clear ROI, and modern vision language models handle mixed-quality photos and multilingual documents reasonably well.

units.summary: The advisors recommended starting with proof-of-delivery documents at the Vantaa site and scaling if the pilot works.
units.quote: We would suggest starting narrow, with one document type, the proof of delivery, and one site, Vantaa, and then scaling if it works.

units.summary: The advisors recommended beginning with one document type, POD, at one site, Vantaa, before scaling.
units.quote: Start with one document type (POD) and one site (Vantaa) before scaling.

units.summary: The workshop listed starting the pilot with Vantaa PODs as a possible approach.
units.quote: Pilot: PODs in Vantaa first?

units.summary: The advisors recommended testing a vision language model on real documents, including poor-quality photos and handwritten remarks, and measuring field-level accuracy against clerk entries.
units.quote: And technically, we would test a vision language model on a sample of your real documents, including the bad photos and the handwritten remarks, and measure field level accuracy against what your clerks entered.

units.summary: The advisors identified handwriting as the main risk and said it should be tested on real samples.
units.quote: Handwriting is the main risk; must be tested on real samples.

units.summary: The proposed design gives the model a confidence level and sends only uncertain documents to a person for checking.
units.quote: The human in the loop design is important, the model gives a confidence level, and only uncertain documents go to a person.

units.summary: The workshop proposed routing only uncertain extracted documents to human review.
units.quote: Fields extracted → TMS via API, human checks only uncertain ones

units.summary: The advisors requested about 200 anonymized real documents covering different types, sites and languages, including at least 50 with handwritten remarks, and clerk-entered data if available for comparison.
units.quote: For the document pilot, a sample of about 200 real documents, anonymized, a mix of types, sites, and languages, and at least 50 with handwritten remarks. And if possible, what the clerks actually entered for those documents, so we can compare.

units.summary: The action items specify an anonymized sample of 200 freight documents across types, sites and languages, including at least 50 with handwritten remarks.
units.quote:
[ ] Jari: send anonymised sample of 200 freight documents (mix of types, sites, languages, at least
    50 with handwritten remarks) - by 30 October 2026.

units.summary: The action items request daily WMS volumes per site for 2020–2026 and the 2025 TMS document log.
units.quote:
[ ] Jari: export daily WMS volumes per site 2020-2026 and the TMS document log for 2025 - by
    30 October 2026.

units.summary: A one-week time study in Vantaa was planned to establish the time taken for each document type.
units.quote: I'll also do a one-week time study in Vantaa, so we know exactly how long each document type takes.

units.summary: The action items assign a one-week time study in Vantaa to collect current clerk time per document type.
units.quote: [ ] Mikko: collect current clerk time per document type (one-week time study in Vantaa).

units.summary: The advisor said a record-by-record API should be sufficient for a pilot because documents are processed one at a time; historical export is more relevant to forecasting.
units.quote: For a pilot, a record-by-record API is usually enough, because you process documents one by one anyway. The historical export matters more for the forecasting case.

units.summary: The advisor said forecasting could be a good topic for a master's thesis.
units.quote: It could be a good topic for a master's thesis student.

units.summary: The customer service case was described as technically quite easy but requiring the most compliance work, and was recommended as a second step after an AI usage policy is in place.
units.quote: Third, the customer service case is technically quite easy, but it has the most compliance work, so it's a good second step once you have an AI usage policy.

units.summary: The advisors described email triage as a good second step after an AI policy exists because it has the most compliance work.
units.quote: Email triage is relatively easy technically but has the most compliance work; good second step once an AI policy exists.

units.summary: The advisors recommended an AI usage policy and short practical Copilot training as quick wins, regardless of the pilots.
units.quote: And fourth, regardless of the pilots, we recommend an AI usage policy and short practical training on Copilot. That is a quick win.

units.summary: The advisors characterized an AI usage policy and short Copilot training as quick wins regardless of the proof of concept.
units.quote: An AI usage policy and short Copilot training are quick wins regardless of the PoC.

units.summary: The advisors said the solution should require little maintenance or be operated by a partner because the company has only one IT person.
units.quote: And because you have only one IT person, the solution must be low maintenance, or operated by a partner.

units.summary: The advisors identified the single-person IT function as a risk and said any solution must be low-maintenance or partner-operated.
units.quote: Risk: single IT person = bottleneck. Any solution must be low-maintenance or partner-operated.

units.summary: Automatic customs declarations were considered too risky to pursue for now.
units.quote: And Kaisa has mentioned automatic customs declarations, but she thinks that's too risky for now.
